atlasLayout: One albedo/normal atlas pair per animation; one row per authored direction and one column per frame. Both maps have identical packing.
frameCoordinates: Resolved from columns, rows, frameWidth, frameHeight, directionRows and framesPerDirection in castle_rat.json.
notes: Runtime uses only four graphical directions. Gameplay movement remains eight-directional. Existing eight-row source atlases are retained during migration, but diagonal rows are never selected.
